notes: Access attempts on 2026-09-24, all anonymous with a generic browser User-Agent and no personal data. (1) doi.org resolves via linkinghub.elsevier.com to ScienceDirect PII S2352431624000956, which returned HTTP 403 with a robot check (captcha). Stopped there; no bypass. (2) A web search indicates the NSF Public Access Repository (funder repository) holds the article. par.nsf.gov failed TLS certificate verification with curl, Python requests and WebFetch; the server presents a chain ending in a private OSTI root ('self-signed certificate in certificate chain'). Verification was not disabled, so this route was not used. (3) The group's publication page (poromechanics.org/publications.html) links only to ScienceDirect. (4) arXiv API: no version. (5) OpenAlex, Crossref and Semantic Scholar hold no abstract, and the pool record has none. (6) ResearchGate was not used (third-party upload site). Method fields are the screening values. For the full-text coder only, not used here: a search-engine summary of the NSF record describes a message-passing GNN filter that removes the grey transition zone on structured and polygonal meshes in 2D and 3D and says it may avoid excessive iterations, which hints at a speed-proxy claim; this is not a primary source. A reader with a trusted route to ScienceDirect or NSF PAR should code this record. No author named Jun Wang. Screening code was I-UNCLEAR.
